findings.issue: r-2 D11 extends the command producer but states no env_clear/allowlist contract; r-2 owns extract/command.rs so its rewrite could regress the a-10 fix.
findings.recommendation: One line in D11 stating the env allowlist contract.

findings.issue: Plan keeps a-10 read caps but does not mention canonicalize/symlink/starts_with rules; D11's new command path inherits any gap.
findings.recommendation: Add 'regular file, canonicalized, starts_with repo root' to the file-input rules D11 cites; confirm a-10 lands before r-2.

findings.issue: Stateless FileSessionStore removes the in-process Mutex; no cross-process model stated (lock vs single writer vs unique-tmp+rename); fixed tmp name per session id; unstated whether ask re-saves; no tmp cleanup/parent fsync/stale sweep.
findings.recommendation: State in D4 + ADR-SAG-0024: no lock; create_new tmp with pid+random, fsync, rename, fsync parent, remove tmp on error, last writer wins, readers protected by digest+id; state whether ask writes; tests: two stores on one dir; stale-tmp sweep.

findings.issue: BusyPolicy has jitter/budget/attempts but (a) no cancellation hook (Python cannot honour KeyboardInterrupt for up to ~210 s), (b) sleep not stated as capped to remaining budget, (c) 120 s timeout not stated to cover body read.
findings.recommendation: CancelToken (Arc<AtomicBool> or trait) checked before each attempt with sliced sleeps; exposed via RunConfig for sc-jev-py; cap sleep at min(Retry-After+jitter, budget_remaining); UreqTransport uses timeout_global incl. body; tests test_retry_sleep_capped_by_budget, test_cancel_interrupts_sleep.

findings.issue: Agent reuse resolved; plan does not say Agent built once in new(); no connect-timeout test.
findings.recommendation: State it; loopback blackhole test ~10 s.

observations: OBS-A (important): r-2b ChainContext appends session context AFTER the per-backend byte-cap validation, so later backends' requests can exceed the cap. Re-run validate_for_send on the final assembled request before each send, or cap the rendered context; test over-cap chained request refused before send.

OBS-B (important): r-2b must state no re-send of a paid call: judge exactly once per backend; only BusyPolicy retries on 429/502/529; transport errors/timeouts after body sent never retried; session-save failure after paid answers returns Ok with session_saved=false + warning; tests test_no_resend_on_timeout, test_session_save_failure_keeps_answers; document 502 duplicate-charge risk or restrict.

OBS-C: r-3 secret sealing via doc(hidden) __transport + clippy lint is advisory; add workspace test that __transport/expose_for_transport appear only in sc-agent-http; deny clippy::allow_attributes; document guarantee is lint+test.
OBS-D: apply redact once in send_with_busy_retry (or NetworkError construction) so redaction does not depend on each Transport impl.

OBS-E: state response cap value (8 MiB) enforced while streaming on error bodies too; bound Retry-After header length; test-only http escape must be cfg(test); release build test asserts http:// refused.
OBS-F: malformed Retry-After = 30 s is harsher than missing = 1 s; consider malformed = 1 s with warning later.
